turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|ASSAY| C[Read received document]
    C --> D[Compress to floor content]
    D --> E[Name evaporated content]
    E --> F[Locate operative sentence]
    F --> G[Report ratio, erosion, and missing rough edge]
    G --> H[Report residue and finding]
    H --> I[This is a finding, not a draft.]

    B -->|PROVIDE| J{Mode stated or inferable?}
    J -->|No| K[Ask for mode]
    K --> L[Wait for answer]
    L --> J
    J -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| M[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    M -->|Gaps| N{How many gaps?}
    N -->|Three or fewer| O[Ask one question naming the gaps]
    N -->|Four or more| P[Ask three largest gaps]
    P --> Q[State assumptions for remaining gaps]
    O --> L
    Q --> L
    M -->|Floor passes| R[Compress the prompt]
    R --> S{Did the cut remove specification?}
    S -->|Yes| T[Name failure and revert]
    T --> R
    S -->|No| U{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    U -->|No| V{Floor still passes?}
    V -->|No| W[Return last passing version]
    V -->|Yes| R
    U -->|Yes| X[Contract is minimal]
    W --> X
    X --> Y[Output contract and cut]
    Y --> Z{Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?}
    Z -->|Keep negotiating| R
    Z -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| AA{Execution tools available?}
    AA -->|No| AB[Gate stays closed]
    AA -->|Yes| AC[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    AC --> AD{Result}
    AD -->|Success| AE[Done]
    AD -->|Floor item fails| AF[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    AF --> R
```

assertions.detail: reverse edge present: L -> J, AF -> R
